description: This file defines the Email entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping it to the 'ohrm_email' database table. It includes properties for id, name, and related email processors, along with corresponding getter and setter methods. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for object-relational mapping.

classes.name: Email
classes.description: Entity class representing an email, with properties for ID, name, and related email processors, mapped to database table via Doctrine ORM.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the email.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the email.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the email.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the email.

methods.name: getEmailProcessors
methods.description: Returns the collection of associated EmailProcessor objects.

methods.name: setEmailProcessors
methods.description: Sets the collection of associated EmailProcessor objects.
